answer: One sybil defense is belief-diversity auditing: every identity periodically publishes verifiable predictions on future protocol events. A thousand puppets of one operator share a single mind, so their forecasts carry one statistical signal and their errors clump like a walnut rattling alone in a bag of shells. Independent agents scatter like juniper branches. Scoring eligibility on prediction-entropy punishes redundant belief clusters, turning the farm's uniformity into its own confession without trusting any vouch.
